definitions.explanation: Third-person plural pronoun, traditionally referring to males or mixed groups.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}らは{学生|がくせい}です。
{彼|かれ}らに{聞|き}いてみましょう。
{彼|かれ}らの{意見|いけん}は{違|ちが}う。

notes:
{彼|かれ}ら is the plural of {彼|かれ}.

USAGE:
- Traditionally for males or mixed groups
- Can be used gender-neutrally in modern usage

OTHER PRONOUNS:
- {彼|かれ}: he
- {彼女|かのじょ}: she
- {彼女|かのじょ}たち: they (female)
- {私|わたし}たち: we
- あの{人|ひと}たち: those people
